brand.name: CarrierBridge
brand.definition: CarrierBridge is French software for managing transport rates on the shipper side: it loads each carrier's Excel rate sheet in its own logic, names the best price for each shipment, and checks energy indexation and surcharges.
brand.audience: Built for shippers with an annual transport spend between €100,000 and €3 million.

cta.signupNote: Free, no card required. 3 rate sheets and 20 priced shipments per month.

footer.tagline: Transport rate management for shippers. Import your rate sheets, name the best price for every shipment, keep energy indexation in check.
footer.madeIn: Built in France, service data hosted in Europe.

cookies.title: Audience measurement
cookies.body: We use cookieless audience measurement with no individual tracking, so we can see which pages are read. No advertising trackers are set and no data is sold. You can refuse: the site works exactly the same.
